source: Fix confirmed Worker HTTP400 incompatibility: only authorized sort_by/date query, filter anime locally after standard genre discovery; remove Novidades cinema/on_the_air conflation, add first-premiere recent movies, new series, season premieres, honest provider arrivals unavailable; expand cinema exclusion, preserve genre page lists. Paginate sorted release data locally to skip future-dated TMDB entries, using only Worker-permitted parameters (commit 75d14b4). Live read-only integration checks for Worker discover/movie, discover/tv and Anime genre 16 before signing.
release_scope: Official signed V2 2.9.45/code74 Android OTA; test and compile sources; preserve V2 signer and cert2026, publish only if previous versionCode less than 74, require HTTPS byte readback.
